headline: COP Q2 Deep Dive: Portfolio Shifts, Leadership Change and Global Growth Initiatives
summary: Oil and gas producer ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 32.4% year on year to $19.52 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.24 per share was 10.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
